packages.name: Piye
packages.trait_help: Ordinary Priests produce +1 Food. +25% Great General emergence within your cultural borders.

unit.name: Kushite Archer
unit.strategy: An early hill fighter with two guaranteed first strikes. Retains the Archer's city and hill defenses and both medieval upgrade paths.

building.name: Napatan Cult Chapel
building.strategy: A Monument replacement with one additional Culture and one Priest slot. Assign a Priest to receive Piye's Food bonus; an empty slot produces nothing. Retains Astronomy obsolescence.

packages.history: Piye ruled Napatan Kush in the eighth century BCE and campaigned into Egypt. His royal inscriptions emphasize Amun and the legitimacy of kingship. This package draws on Napatan religious institutions rather than the much later ironworking identity often associated with Meroe. The cult chapel is a repeatable gameplay institution, not a claim that an identical royal monument stood in every settlement.
packages.art_status: Existing primary and separate nonshader model retained. Package XML confirms the 64px Piye.dds portrait. Stock Archer and Monument art are provisional, not claimed as final Nubian costume or architecture. Full diplomacy/graphics acceptance pending.
packages.flag_note: Original geometric gold winged solar disk on purple, inspired by ancient Nile religious imagery. Modern gameplay reconstruction, not an attested national flag or an archaeological facsimile.

packages.name: Stefan Dusan
packages.trait_help: Mines produce +1 Commerce yield when worked. Ordinary Priests produce +1 Espionage.

unit.name: Vlastela Cavalry
unit.strategy: A Knight replacement with +25% hills attack and +25% against Melee units. Requires both Horse and Iron, Guilds and Horseback Riding. Pikemen remain a serious counter.

building.name: Zakonik Court
building.strategy: A Courthouse replacement with -60% maintenance in total and +2 Culture. Retains the ordinary Courthouse's +2 Espionage and Spy slot.

packages.history: Stefan Dusan ruled a fourteenth-century Serbian empire and promulgated his law code in 1349. The Vlastela represents medieval noble cavalry, while the court and mining-based economy abstract legal administration and developed mining settlements. These are not later Hajduk, Chetnik or modern cavalry formations. The Priest's Espionage represents literate institutions in the game's specialist system, not a historical claim about a spy religion.
packages.art_status: Existing package explicitly uses the primary Putin.nif in both shader fields; retained without claiming nonshader runtime certification. Package XML confirms dusan.dds portrait. Stock medieval Knight and Courthouse visuals are provisional. No later Serbian uniform imports.
packages.flag_note: Original geometric white double-headed eagle on red, inspired by medieval Serbian imperial heraldry. A simplified gameplay reconstruction, not a claim to reproduce a surviving personal standard.

packages.name: Matthias Corvinus
packages.trait_help: Melee and Gunpowder units receive Paid Professionals: 25% cheaper upgrades, retained normally on upgrading or gifting. Ordinary Artists produce +1 Research.

unit.name: Black Army Arquebusier
unit.strategy: A stronger Musketman replacement with Drill I, costing 100 Production and one additional Gold per turn in unit costs. Retains Gunpowder and the Rifleman upgrade.

building.name: Corvinian College
building.strategy: Retains Education, 200 Production and +25% Research. Adds +3 Culture and one Artist slot. Assigned Artists receive the leader trait's Research bonus.

packages.history: Matthias Corvinus ruled Hungary from 1458 to 1490. His paid forces included early handgun troops, while his court supported Renaissance learning. The college abstracts scholarly patronage rather than placing copies of the royal library in every city. The Black Army's professionalism came with real financial costs. The unit uses the game's Gunpowder tier, not later mounted Cuirassier equipment.
packages.art_status: Retained primary/nonshader geometry and costume. Missing stock Darius specular map restored with matching donor normal/environment/mask evidence. No supplied portrait button: explicitly provisional original raven-emblem button, not a portrait or an audit render. Stock Gunpowder infantry and University art are prototypes, not authenticated Black Army uniforms or a royal-library model.

repairs.evidence: Darius NRML.dds, Darius_ENV.dds and Darius_ENVMask.dds in Matthias match stock Darius byte-for-byte; both retained NIFs reference the missing stock Darius_SPEC.dds.

packages.flag_note: Original geometric raven holding a gold ring on pale gold, inspired by Corvinian heraldry. A simplified provisional emblem, not a facsimile of a historical royal banner.

packages.name: Pedro II
packages.trait_help: Ordinary Scientists produce +1 Culture; ordinary Artists produce +1 Research. +25% Great Person rate.

unit.name: Voluntarios da Patria
unit.strategy: A Rifleman replacement costing 100 Production, with March. Retains strength 14, Rifling, no resource requirement and the Infantry upgrade. No extra drafting or free unit spawning.

building.name: Imperial Lyceum
building.strategy: A University replacement with +35% Research in total, +1 Culture and one Artist slot. Retains Education and the parent's other prerequisites.

packages.history: Pedro II reigned in Brazil from 1831 to 1889 and cultivated scientific and scholarly interests. The Voluntarios da Patria represents forces raised during the 1860s war, but recruitment was not uniformly voluntary: coercion and slavery must not be erased from that history. The Lyceum represents educational institutions rather than a claim that the emperor built an identical royal college in every city.
packages.art_status: Existing aging bearded imperial portrait and bundled 64px pedro.dds retained provisionally. No conflicting Pedro I metadata found; final identity approval remains open. Unused BoundShape/Suleiman helper meshes and stored background tilt are untouched. Stock nineteenth-century Rifleman/University art is explicitly provisional.
packages.flag_note: Original simplified green field, gold lozenge and blue imperial medallion with a gold crown. Provisional Second Empire-inspired reconstruction, not a modern republican flag or a facsimile of the full imperial arms.

packages.name: Mongkut
packages.trait_help: +20 research-modifier percentage points for a technology known to at least one alive foreign Open Borders team. Does not stack per partner; excludes war, your own team and either-direction vassal relations.

unit.name: Siamese Royal Rifle
unit.strategy: A defensive Rifleman replacement with Drill I and +25% city defense, costing 120 Production. Retains strength 14, Rifling, the anti-mounted modifier and the Infantry upgrade.

building.name: Royal Observatory
building.strategy: An Observatory replacement with two Scientist slots in total and +1 Culture. Retains Astronomy, 150 Production and +25% Research. This city building is separate from the Great Scientist's mountain Research Campus.

packages.history: Mongkut, Rama IV, ruled Siam from 1851 to 1868 after a long period in the Buddhist monkhood. His scientific interests and international diplomacy inform this package's conditional research access. Later reforms under Chulalongkorn must not be retroactively assigned to him. The Royal Rifle and Observatory are gameplay abstractions, not claims that a uniform regiment or identical royal observatory existed in every Siamese city.
packages.art_status: Retained primary mesh, costume, background and bundled portrait. Missing eye material restored from the identical shared stock eyeshadow already bundled under frederick_eyeshadow.dds. No distinct nonshader model; low-graphics acceptance remains pending. Stock Rifleman and Observatory art are provisional, not authenticated Siamese uniforms or architecture.

repairs.evidence: PyFFI resolves the 24-vertex eyeshadow geometry's base texture to missing eyeshadow.dds. The already bundled frederick_eyeshadow.dds is byte-identical to stock Justinian's shared eyeshadow.dds (192 bytes), not a replacement portrait texture.

packages.flag_note: Original simplified white elephant on red, inspired by nineteenth-century Siamese flags. Provisional geometric reconstruction, not an exact drawing of a surviving royal standard.

packages.name: Simon Bolivar
packages.trait_help: New military-conquest occupation is halved, rounded up. No reduction for peaceful transfers or an already running timer. +50% Great General rate.

unit.name: Llanero
unit.strategy: A Cavalry replacement with three movement and 40% total withdrawal, costing 140 Production. Retains strength 15, Military Tradition, Rifling, Horseback Riding, Horse and the Gunship upgrade. Other units do not gain movement.

building.name: Republican Cabildo
building.strategy: A Courthouse replacement granting +2 experience to land units trained here. Retains 120 Production, Code of Laws, the parent's maintenance modifier, Espionage and Spy slot. Sea and air units receive no experience bonus.

packages.history: Simon Bolivar was a central figure in northern South American independence and the republic commonly called Gran Colombia, which existed from 1819 to 1831. Llanero cavalry served opposing sides as well as independence forces; the unit is a regional cavalry abstraction rather than a claim of uniform political loyalty. The Cabildo represents civic institutions. This package is not the modern Republic of Colombia and uses no modern Search Bloc imagery.
packages.art_status: Retained primary model, portrait content, costume and background geometry/camera. The supplied 61x61 portrait is resampled to a separate 64x64 RGBA runtime button; original retained. Runtime KFM changes only its missing donor model binding to bundled Bolivar.nif; all animation bytes retained. A reviewed background repair keeps the donor's two matching constant root controllers and verifies their composed orientation equals the retained NIF; absent sky/material targets are omitted. No distinct nonshader model. Stock nineteenth-century Cavalry and Courthouse visuals are provisional; no modern Search Bloc substitution.

repairs.evidence: Roster gate rejects the supplied non-power-of-two DDS. Preserve the original; LANCZOS-resample the same complete RGBA portrait to 64x64 and encode uncompressed DDS without cropping or substituting art.
The original KFM points at an absent donor model. Only its length-prefixed model field changes; the _alex_parent skeleton and all existing eight animation filenames/transitions remain byte-identical.

tools/prepare_bolivar_background.py (PyFFI 2.2.3) verifies pinned donor/model hashes, retains only _julius_caesar_parent and NonAccum constant transform links, excludes the two absent targets and checks composed orientation within 1e-5. Thirteen repository donor clips share the source hash. No background mesh, material, camera or head-animation change.

packages.flag_note: Original geometric yellow-blue-red independence-era tricolor abstraction. No copied arms, stars or modern state insignia; provisional identification for the 1819-1831 republic, not an exact claim for every historical flag variant.

packages.name: Hiram I
packages.trait_help: Each coastal city gains +1 Gold per distinct foreign team represented in active trade routes, capped at +3. Same-team routes do not count; repeated routes to one team count once. Losing routes removes their eligibility.

unit.name: Tyrian Merchant Galley
unit.strategy: A Galley replacement with three movement, costing 60 Production. Retains strength 2, normal cargo capacity, Sailing, ocean restrictions and the Galleon upgrade. A ship's presence does not establish a free trade connection.

building.name: Tyrian Counting House
building.strategy: A Market replacement with +25% foreign trade-route modifier. Retains Currency, 150 Production, +25% Gold and two Merchant slots. This is not another +25% empire-wide Gold bonus.

packages.history: Hiram I is associated with early first-millennium BCE Tyre and traditions of timber, craft exchange and royal diplomacy. Exact chronology and associations with David and Solomon rely heavily on later textual traditions. He is not credited here with founding later Carthage. The city list spans Phoenician coastal settlements for gameplay and does not claim that every settlement belonged to his kingdom. The merchant ship and counting house abstract maritime exchange rather than reproducing a documented named regiment or identical civic building.
packages.art_status: Primary visible scene, distinct nonshader model, background, animations and 64px portrait retained. The primary file's missing saruman.dds references belonged to five separate non-scene export roots. A separate runtime NIF omits those roots and verifies exact serialized data/reference preservation for every visible scene block; no guessed donor texture is substituted. Runtime KFM changes only the model filename. Stock Galley/Market art and inherited Mediterranean citystyles are provisional.

repairs.evidence: tools/prepare_hiram_leaderhead.py (PyFFI 2.2.3) verifies the sole NiAVObject export root is Scene Root and none of the other five roots is reachable from it. Both missing saruman.dds references belong to a separate NiTexturingProperty root. Every active scene block serializes identically before and after repair, including reference indices, geometry, transforms and materials.
Reviewed little-endian KFM 2.0.0.0b: only the length-prefixed model name changes. _darius_parent and all animation/transition bytes remain identical.

packages.flag_note: Original geometric merchant vessel with pale sail and gold hull on Tyrian purple. Modern gameplay emblem inspired by Phoenician maritime exchange, not an attested national flag or copied ancient illustration.

packages.name: Ramkhamhaeng
packages.trait_help: From Writing, each owned, assigned and worked riverside Farm gives its city +1 Culture before modifiers, capped at +3 per city. No Food bonus or unworked payment; Ho Trai is not required.

unit.name: Sukhothai War Elephant
unit.strategy: A War Elephant replacement costing 65 Production with 20% withdrawal. Retains strength 8, movement 1, Ivory, Construction and Horseback Riding, anti-mounted role and the Cuirassier upgrade. No resource exemption.

building.name: Ho Trai
building.strategy: A Library replacement costing 100 Production. Adds two Culture above the parent and one Priest slot while retaining Writing, +25% Research, two Scientist slots and the parent's existing Culture. No religion requirement.

packages.history: Ramkhamhaeng is associated with late-thirteenth-century Sukhothai kingship, script traditions and Buddhist learning. The inscription's authenticity, idealized royal portrait and the extent of direct rule remain subjects of scholarship. The city list uses regional settlement names for gameplay, not a map of uncontested personal dominion. Ho Trai represents manuscript learning, while the elephant unit is a regional military abstraction rather than a named historical formation.
packages.art_status: Existing red-and-gold primary, distinct nonshader model, background and 64px portrait retained. Referenced dependencies resolve. Stock Elephant and Library visuals with inherited Khmer citystyles are provisional; a movie image is not treated as a building model. Full animation and shader acceptance pending.
packages.flag_note: Original geometric gold lotus and paired river lines on deep red. Provisional religious/agrarian gameplay emblem, not an attested Sukhothai national flag or copied religious illustration.

packages.name: Ho Chi Minh
packages.trait_help: Owned, assigned and worked Forest/Jungle plots give +1 city Production each, capped at +3 before modifiers. +50% domestic Great General rate. Clearing woodland removes its eligibility.

unit.name: Viet Minh Infantry
unit.strategy: An Infantry replacement with strength 18 and cost 120, receiving Woodsman I and II. Retains Assembly Line, Rifling, the parent's anti-gunpowder modifier and upgrades. No invisibility, free partisan spawning, mountain movement or nationality masking.

building.name: Resistance Headquarters
building.strategy: An Intelligence Agency replacement with +15% military Production. Retains the live Utopia prerequisite, cost 180, +8 Espionage, +50% Espionage and two Spy slots.

packages.history: Ho Chi Minh was a leading figure in the Viet Minh independence movement and the Democratic Republic proclaimed in 1945. The Viet Minh is distinguished here from the later Viet Cong. Woodland logistics and the headquarters are game abstractions, not claims that all Vietnamese forces were jungle guerrillas or that every city held an identical resistance institution. The package does not transplant Mao's worked-Farm Espionage mechanic.
packages.art_status: Blue-shirt primary and all original textures remain unchanged. Separate fallback changes only the Mao-new clothing geometry's unique base-texture filename to the primary blue diffuse map; all 1794 clothing UVs match exactly, and restoring that filename reproduces the complete original canonical NIF. Face, beard, geometry and other fallback materials are untouched. Runtime KFM changes only its missing donor model binding. Stock Infantry/Intelligence Agency and inherited Asian citystyles are provisional; runtime animation/shader acceptance pending.

repairs.evidence: tools/prepare_expansion_texture_paths.py verifies one unshared clothing texture and identical primary/fallback clothing UVs. Only the chosen length-prefixed filename bytes change; reversing the change also reproduces the full canonical NIF.
Filename-only KFM 2.0.0.0b repair. All animation and transition bytes are preserved.

packages.flag_note: Original geometric five-pointed gold star on red, drawn from simple polygons. Period identification rather than a copied modern graphic; provisional square gameplay proportions.

packages.name: Askia Muhammad
packages.trait_help: Owned, assigned and worked riverside Cottage/Hamlet/Village/Town plots give +1 city Gold each, capped at +4 across all four stages before modifiers. No Farm bonus or additional trade-route modifier.

unit.name: Sahelian Escort Cavalry
unit.strategy: A Knight replacement with Sentry and 20% withdrawal. Retains cost 90, strength 10, movement 2, Guilds and Horseback Riding, Horse AND Iron, normal restrictions and the Cuirassier upgrade. A regional cavalry abstraction, not a named regiment.

building.name: Timbuktu Scholarly College
building.strategy: A University replacement costing 180 Production with one Priest slot. Retains Education, +25% Research and the parent's existing Culture. Not a duplicate University of Sankore wonder or a new religion.

packages.history: Askia Muhammad ruled Songhai from 1493 to 1528 and is associated with administrative organization, trade regulation and scholarly patronage. Religious scholarship is not modeled as universal population conversion. The regional city list describes a broad gameplay setting rather than identical degrees of control over every settlement. The college and escort cavalry abstract institutions and military roles, not a documented standardized building or named regiment.
packages.art_status: Red turban, face, costume, background and 64px portrait retained. Runtime NIF changes only the zara_trans mesh's obsolete absolute base-texture filename to bundled Zara_DIFF.dds. Reversing that change reproduces every original canonical byte. Runtime KFM changes only model filename. No distinct nonshader model exists; the primary is provisional in both fields, not certified for low settings. Stock Knight/University and inherited African citystyles are provisional.

repairs.evidence: tools/prepare_expansion_texture_paths.py verifies the exact source, one unshared zara_trans texture reference and whole-document canonical equality after reversing only the absolute-to-relative filename edit.
Filename-only KFM 2.0.0.0b repair; parent, animation and transition bytes are preserved.

packages.flag_note: Original geometric gold earthen tower and open manuscript above blue river lines on dark green. A scholarly/commercial gameplay reconstruction, not an attested Askia standard or copied mosque illustration.

packages.name: David
packages.trait_help: +3 city Culture once while at least one owned, non-cargo, non-animal, combat-capable land unit of level 3 or higher occupies the city tile. +25% domestic Great General rate. Additional veterans do not stack the Culture.

unit.name: Gibbor Royal Retainer
unit.strategy: A Swordsman replacement costing 45 Production, with +25% city attack in total and +25% hills defense. Requires Copper OR Iron and Iron Working. Retains strength 6, movement 1 and Maceman upgrade. An infantry-tier abstraction, not a reconstructed dated uniform.

building.name: Royal Citadel
building.strategy: A Walls replacement costing 60 Production with +1 Culture and one Priest slot. Retains Masonry, normal defenses and Rifling obsolescence. Buildable on flatland; this is not Solomon's Temple.

packages.history: David is traditionally placed in the early first millennium BCE. The extent of the united monarchy and much biographical detail remain debated; royal retainers and songs draw on textual traditions rather than a securely reconstructed administrative program. The city list is an ancient literary/historical gameplay setting, not a claim of uniform control or a modern-state analogy. The game's Judaism preference is a broad abstraction. No new religion or Temple wonder is added, and Solomon's Temple is not attributed to David.
packages.art_status: Existing primary, costume, animation files and static background retained provisionally by explicit owner request despite the audit's remake recommendation. No distinct nonshader model or portrait button exists; the primary is used in both fields, and an original harp emblem is explicitly not a portrait. Missing Julius background TGA is restored from repeated identical repository DDS pixels with matching background geometry and UV evidence. Stock Swordsman/Walls and inherited Middle Eastern citystyles are provisional; later Maccabee art is not misrepresented as Davidic.

repairs.evidence: Owain and Mangal Pandey bundle identical 512x256 RGBA Julius background DDS files. Their Alexander background plane matches David's background_stub art geometry and UVs exactly (vertex SHA256 96e82d9ab36aa307ead5eea28d35641bd2bde99b5b6012ac1b88f9508bcddf68; UV SHA256 6c747f491fd8f84bfcf73978c1daeae7d39a623baff994c7d8eaa39a2beab112). Lossless decoded-pixel conversion to the referenced TGA leaves the NIF and existing Cyrus textures untouched.

packages.flag_note: Original geometric gold harp on deep blue, referring to the literary tradition of Davidic songs. Explicitly a provisional gameplay emblem, not an attested ancient national flag or a modern-state symbol.
